overlap.formal_difference: No difference interval is reported between the Feynman benchmark and the expanded Feynman corpus, because the benchmark equations are part of the expanded corpus. Each formula has one bootstrap multiplicity across all of its branches. Chapter resampling shares one multiplicity across all formulas in a chapter.
